text.p: Cascade Corp Wednesday said its board of directors increased the quarterly dividend to $0.10 a share from $0.09, payable June 6 to shareholders of record on May 23.

In a statement, the company said executives told shareholders at the company's annual meeting recent acquisitions will add about $150 million in revenues to Cascade's results over the next 12 months. The company said management is optimistic the acquisitions will be at least modestly accretive to Cascade's total earnings in the year ending January 31, 1998.
However, the company said amortization of goodwill and interest payments on additional debt will adversely affect earnings for the year.

Another factor that will adversely impact first quarter results only will be inventory valuation adjustments at Industrial Tires Ltd and Kenhar Corp, which are mandated under the rules of purchase accounting.
